The Portronics Moji 10, 10000mAh mini Powerbank, Detachable Type C Cable, LED Indicator, 20W Wired Output is designed for users who need fast, reliable charging in a compact and travel-friendly size. Built for everyday commuters, professionals, and students, this high-capacity yet pocket-sized power bank ensures your smartphone, earbuds, tablet, or other USB-C devices stay powered wherever you go.

With its powerful 10000mAh battery, the Portronics Moji 10 delivers multiple recharges while remaining lightweight and easy to carry. The integrated detachable Type C cable removes the need to carry extra wires, making it a perfect companion for travel, office, or emergency use. Whether you are catching flights, attending meetings, or streaming on the move, this fast charging power bank keeps your devices ready.

The 20W wired output supports rapid charging for compatible smartphones and gadgets, helping reduce downtime. The smart LED indicator keeps you informed about the remaining battery level so you can plan your charging needs efficiently. Designed with safety and performance in mind, the Portronics Moji 10 offers advanced protection against overheating, overcharging, and short circuits.

Key Features of Portronics Moji 10 Power Bank

  • High-capacity 10000mAh mini powerbank for reliable backup power
  • Detachable Type C cable for convenient, tangle-free charging
  • 20W wired output for fast charging support
  • LED indicator to display battery status
  • Compact, lightweight, and ideal for travel
  • Universal compatibility with smartphones, tablets, and accessories
  • Multi-layer chipset protection for safe usage

The compact design makes this mini power bank easy to slip into your pocket or backpack. Despite the small size, the power-packed performance ensures efficient charging for Android devices, USB-C enabled iPhones, Bluetooth earphones, smartwatches, and more. The detachable Type C cable is especially useful for users who prefer minimal accessories while on the move.

If you are searching for a fast charging 10000mAh power bank with cable, the Portronics Moji 10 stands out with its premium finish and durable build. It is ideal for corporate gifting, personal use, and tech-savvy users who value portability without compromising on output power.

The LED indicator helps monitor charging and remaining capacity, eliminating guesswork. Simply plug in your device and experience stable, optimized charging speeds. The 20W wired output is engineered to support quick top-ups, giving you hours of usage in minutes.

Frequent travelers will appreciate how this lightweight power bank fits easily in cabin luggage or handbags. Office professionals can keep it at their desks for quick boosts between meetings. Students and content creators can rely on uninterrupted power throughout the day.

With universal compatibility and smart power management, the Portronics Moji 10 is more than just a backup battery—it is a daily utility gadget. The detachable Type C cable ensures you are always prepared, while the ergonomic form factor makes handling effortless.

Why Choose Portronics Moji 10?

  • Trusted quality and durability
  • Portable mini power bank with high efficiency
  • Fast, stable, and secure wired charging
  • Great for travel, office, and everyday carry
  • Excellent gifting option for employees and clients

Upgrade to smarter portable charging with the and enjoy dependable power anytime, anywhere.
